name: bld3_pow_prime_mem_center_of_card_prime_cube
statement: (p : ℕ) (hp : p.Prime) (G : Type*) [Group G] (hG : Nat.card G = p ^ 3) (hna : ∃ a b : G, a * b ≠ b * a) (g : G) : g ^ p ∈ Subgroup.center G
closed: ∀ (p : ℕ) (hp : p.Prime) (G : Type*) [Group G] (hG : Nat.card G = p ^ 3) (hna : ∃ a b : G, a * b ≠ b * a) (g : G), g ^ p ∈ Subgroup.center G
informal: Uses Mathlib2.bld_center_card_of_card_prime_cube and Mathlib2.bld2_commutator_eq_center_of_card_prime_cube: the centre has order p so G/Z has order p^2 and is not cyclic (else G abelian), hence every element of G/Z has order dividing p, i.e. g^p ∈ Z.
type: ∀ (p : ℕ), Nat.Prime p → ∀ (G : Type u_1) [inst : Group G], Nat.card G = p ^ 3 → (∃ a b, a * b ≠ b * a) → ∀ (g : G), g ^ p ∈ Subgroup.center G
